newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland clears metals trader Impexmetal for trade.
newsitem.headline: Poland clears metals trader Impexmetal for trade.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) has cleared for public trade all the shares in metals trader Impexmetal SA, whose initial public offering is set for April, the KPW said in a statement on Friday.

Impexmetal president Edward Wojtulewicz, at a news conference after the shares were cleared, said the firm sought to take in about $40 million from its new share issue, which would have the same price as shares sold by the state treasury.
"It's hard to say what price the treasury ministry will set, but we see it (the firm's proceeds) in the area of $40 million," Wojtulewicz said.
He said the firm expected international and domestic institutional investors to take up shares and that the new issue, which he saw fully underwritten, would likely not have trouble being subscribed.
He also said the firm was mulling floating some of the 83 percent of shares it holds in the Konin SA aluminum plant.

Use Of Proceeds: investment in firms in holding, upgrade computer system, 20 percent of proceeds for paying debts, NOTE: Book-building will help set minimum issue price.
